title: Bound total JSON containers before parsing

context.hint: Bound structural expansion of worker-produced findings before JSON parsing.
context.surface: A parent process validates findings documents supplied by a lower-trust worker.
assumptions: Run resource probes in disposable subprocesses with an external timeout.

review.invariant: A findings document cannot exceed the configured total container budget before parsing allocates its objects.
review.verification: Use a configurable small budget and inputs below and above it. Require a bounded validation error above the limit. Run any larger resource probe under an explicit process limit.

source_observation.summary: A baseline document within byte and depth limits exhausted the constrained process heap. The repaired validator rejected excessive structure cleanly. The observed crash depended on a constrained heap.
